import argparse
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from inventory.core import Inventory


def _build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="inventory")
    parser.add_argument("--db", required=True, type=Path, help="path to the JSON database")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    add = commands.add_parser("add", help="add stock of an item")
    add.add_argument("name")
    add.add_argument("qty", type=int)

    remove = commands.add_parser("remove", help="remove stock of an item")
    remove.add_argument("name")
    remove.add_argument("qty", type=int)

    commands.add_parser("list", help="list all items")
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = _build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    inventory = Inventory.load(args.db)
    try:
        if args.command == "add":
            inventory.add(args.name, args.qty)
            inventory.save(args.db)
        elif args.command == "remove":
            inventory.remove(args.name, args.qty)
            inventory.save(args.db)
        else:
            for name, qty in inventory.items():
                print(f"{name} {qty}")
    except (KeyError, ValueError) as exc:
        message = exc.args[0] if exc.args else exc
        print(f"error: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import json

import pytest

from inventory.cli import main
from inventory.core import Inventory


def test_load_missing_file_is_empty(tmp_path):
    assert Inventory.load(tmp_path / "missing.json").items() == []


def test_save_then_load_round_trips_with_sorted_keys(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "db.json"
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("pear", 2)
    inv.add("apple", 5)
    inv.save(path)

    assert list(json.loads(path.read_text())) == ["apple", "pear"]
    assert Inventory.load(path).items() == [("apple", 5), ("pear", 2)]


def test_add_accumulates_quantity():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("bolt", 3)
    inv.add("bolt", 4)
    assert inv.items() == [("bolt", 7)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("qty", [0, -1, 1.5, "2", True])
def test_add_rejects_non_positive_or_non_int(qty):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Inventory().add("bolt", qty)


def test_remove_reduces_quantity():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("bolt", 5)
    inv.remove("bolt", 2)
    assert inv.items() == [("bolt", 3)]


def test_remove_to_zero_deletes_item():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("bolt", 5)
    inv.remove("bolt", 5)
    assert inv.items() == []


def test_remove_unknown_item_raises_key_error():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        Inventory().remove("bolt", 1)


def test_remove_more_than_stock_raises_value_error():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("bolt", 2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        inv.remove("bolt", 3)
    assert inv.items() == [("bolt", 2)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("qty", [0, -4, 2.0])
def test_remove_rejects_non_positive_or_non_int(qty):
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("bolt", 5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        inv.remove("bolt", qty)


def test_items_sorted_by_name():
    inv = Inventory()
    inv.add("zinc", 1)
    inv.add("axe", 2)
    assert inv.items() == [("axe", 2), ("zinc", 1)]


def test_cli_add_list_remove_persist_to_db(tmp_path, capsys):
    db = tmp_path / "db.json"

    assert main(["--db", str(db), "add", "bolt",

"5"]) == 0
    assert main(["--db", str(db), "add", "nut", "2"]) == 0
    assert main(["--db", str(db), "remove", "bolt", "1"]) == 0
    capsys.readouterr()

    assert main(["--db", str(db), "list"]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "bolt 4\nnut 2\n"
    assert json.loads(db.read_text()) == {"bolt": 4, "nut": 2}


def test_cli_list_empty_prints_nothing(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert main(["--db", str(tmp_path / "db.json"), "list"]) == 0
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == ""


def test_cli_remove_unknown_item_reports_error(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert main(["--db", str(tmp_path / "db.json"), "remove", "bolt", "1"]) == 1
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == ""
    assert captured.err.startswith("error: ")


def test_cli_remove_too_many_reports_error_and_keeps_db(tmp_path, capsys):
    db = tmp_path / "db.json"
    main(["--db", str(db), "add", "bolt", "1"])
    capsys.readouterr()

    assert main(["--db", str(db), "remove", "bolt", "2"]) == 1
    assert "error: " in capsys.readouterr().err
    assert json.loads(db.read_text()) == {"bolt": 1}


def test_cli_add_non_positive_reports_error(tmp_path, capsys):
    assert main(["--db", str(tmp_path / "db.json"), "add", "bolt", "0"]) == 1
    assert capsys.readouterr().err.startswith("error: ")
